title: Summit Borrower Protections, Payoff Plans and Servicing Features
content:
Protections and servicing features of the Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage, by plan.

## Protections and servicing features

| Plan | Non-recourse | What a retaining heir pays | Non-borrowing spouse may remain after the borrower's death | Annual occupancy certification | Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve may be set up at closing | Cedarline may advance unpaid property charges | Draws stop once a maturity case is opened |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Fixed Lump Sum | yes | lesser of the balance or 95% of the appraised value | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Summit Flex Fixed | yes | lesser of the balance or 95% of the appraised value | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Summit Select Line | yes | lesser of the balance or 95% of the appraised value | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Summit Condo Line | yes | lesser of the balance or 95% of the appraised value | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Summit Second Lien | yes | lesser of the balance or 95% of the appraised value | no | yes | no | yes | yes |
| Summit Estate Line | yes | lesser of the balance or 95% of the appraised value | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

The non-borrowing spouse protection is the company's spouse protection rider. Repayment of every Summit loan is limited to the home's value.

## Payoff plans available

Every Summit plan offers the same five payoff plans:

- Borrower Voluntary Payoff
- Heir Retention Payoff
- Estate Market Sale Payoff
- Approved Short Sale Payoff
- Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure

## Where the Summit Second Lien differs

The Summit Second Lien is the one plan under which a surviving non-borrowing spouse has no right to remain under the spouse protection rider, and under which no Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve may be set up at closing. Its other protections match the remaining plans.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

A retaining heir on a hypothetical Summit loan with a balance of USD 488210.64 and a home appraised at USD 451000.00 pays the lesser of the balance and 95% of the appraised value (USD 428450.00), which is USD 428450.00. Had the balance been USD 402377.18, the heir would pay the balance, USD 402377.18, as the lesser figure.
